small_guidance:
- Add larger-tile autotune configs targeting OC=64 fully (BLOCK_N=64 fixed) with bigger BLOCK_M (256, 512) and num_warps=8, num_stages=3/4 — N_OUT = 128*126*126 ≈ 2M is huge, so larger M-tiles reduce launch/index overhead.
- Try BLOCK_N=32 configs since OC=64 only needs 2 N-tiles; pairing BLOCK_M=256, BLOCK_N=32, num_warps=4 may improve occupancy and reduce wasted work on the OC tail.
- Swizzle/group the program-id ordering (group along OW so consecutive pid_m share `b,oh` and reuse x rows across kh*kw gather) to improve L2 reuse of input loads.
large_guidance:
- Switch from per-output-pixel im2col gather to an implicit-GEMM with K-loop over (kh,kw) and tiled inner-K=IC, but tile the spatial output as a 2D (OH_tile × OW_tile) block per program so neighboring outputs share input rows for huge L1/L2 reuse (current scheme treats output as a 1D N_OUT, losing 2D locality).
- Use channels-last (NHWC) input layout end-to-end and avoid the IC padding to 16: with IC=8, pad-to-16 doubles the K work. Instead pad to next-power-of-two=8 (or 16 only if needed) and load IC contiguously as the GEMM-K — current kernel does 2× the FMAs needed.
- Consider a persistent kernel: one program per SM iterating over a queue of (b, oh_tile, oc_tile) tiles, amortizing the weight load (KH*KW*IC*OC = 3*3*8*64 = 4.5KB fits easily in shared/registers) across many output tiles.
